svg.text: Find the right directory and subscription
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Sign in to the Azure portal. Open the account/directory menu and record the tenant. Search
Subscriptions and select the exact lab subscription; confirm it is active before trying to
If your subscription must be restored or created, use Microsoft’s billing/signup process and
read its offer and payment terms yourself. Do not create subscriptions to evade trial limits,
and do not assume an old offer restarts.
Use a dedicated lab subscription with no business resources for the subscription-wide portal
demonstration. A new resource group by itself does not limit a subscription-wide Defender
Check: You can identify the exact tenant, active subscription and intended lab boundary.
